extraction.text:
Arnab Khan

Software Engineer - III

+91 7873255840 | arnabkhan19951@outlook.com | LinkedIn | Bengaluru

	PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY	

7+ years of professional experience in software development specializing in Java and Spring Boot. Expertise in application development, API design (high-level and low-level), and software trade-offs. Strong background in distributed systems, microservices, and monolithic architectures. Proficient in handling NoSQL and relational databases (e.g., AWS DynamoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL). Skilled in technical leadership and stakeholder management with a focus on delivering scalable and efficient engineering solutions.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Programming Languages: Java | Frameworks: Spring Boot | Backend: System Architecture, API Design, Technical Specifications, Microservices, Monoliths | Tools: Git, AWS, Kubernetes, Apache Kafka | Databases: NoSQL Databases, Relational Databases, AWS DynamoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Apache Cassandra | Platforms: Rakuten Cloud Platform, Unix/Linux | Others: Tech Ownership, Stakeholder Management, Communication

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE (7+ Years)

Software Engineer - III | Jan 2022 - Present

HashedIn By Deloitte | Bengaluru

Led the development of REST APIs for plan order management, reducing average order processing time by 30% and driving a 12% increase in client revenue through improved operational efficiency.

Collaborated with engineers, product managers, and clients (e.g., Cargill, Footlocker) to gather and implement end-to-end business and engineering requirements, ensuring timely delivery of feature enhancements.

Authored ~25 technical specifications (high-level and low-level designs), reducing onboarding time for new engineers by 15% through structured documentation and mentoring.

Promoted better coding practices and proactive development approaches, achieving a 40% decrease in production bugs and a 35% reduction in post-mortem incidents.

Drove seamless integration and scalability for a streamlined order experience, providing clear technical direction and support to the team.

Facilitated regular code reviews and technical discussions to maintain high-quality standards, ensuring zero missed release deadlines during organizational restructurings.

Contributed to Deloitte securing 3 additional projects from existing clients by delivering impactful and measurable solutions.

Member of Technical Staff | Nov 2020 - Jan 2022

Altiostar Network | Bengaluru

Designed the architecture for 5G Element Management Software and led the end-to-end setup and bring-up on Rakuten Cloud Platform, including upgrade procedures and basic debugging on Unix/Linux platforms.

Developed an XML Parsing Tool to manage and process performance monitoring (PM) files, improving data handling efficiency.

Created an XML comparison tool to automate file comparisons, storing results in Excel for streamlined analysis and reporting.

Worked on OBF Automation, enhancing the handling of PM files and improving overall system performance.

Project Engineer | Jul 2018 - Nov 2020

Wipro Technologies | Hyderabad

Contributed to the introduction of Apache Pulsar as the client's messaging platform by creating pub-sub libraries, improving speed and latency through benchmarking.

Configured distributed databases (Apache Cassandra) and messaging platforms (Apache Kafka) to optimize system performance.

Developed a secret management service using AWS Lambda, KMS, and IAM roles, reducing dependency on Vault and ensuring secure access to secrets.



Gained experience in Object-Oriented Analysis and Design (OOAD) techniques, applying them to enhance software design and implementation.

PROJECTS

Plan Order Management APIs | Jan 2022 - Present

HashedIn By Deloitte

Developed REST APIs to optimize plan order processing, reducing average processing time by 30% and increasing client revenue by 12%.

Ensured seamless integration and scalability for a streamlined order experience.

5G Element Management Software | Nov 2020 - Jan 2022

Altiostar Network

Designed the architecture and led the setup of 5G Element Management Software on Rakuten Cloud Platform.

Automated XML parsing and comparison processes for performance monitoring data.

Secret Management Service | Jul 2018 - Nov 2020

Wipro Technologies

Built a secure secret management service using AWS Lambda, KMS, and IAM roles, reducing dependency on third-party tools.

Improved encryption and secure access practices for sensitive data.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Technology | Computer Science & Engineering | Apr 2018

KIIT University | Bhubaneswar, India
